summary: Hunters are ranged physical fighters who use bows, guns and crossbows, tame beasts as pets, and control fights with traps, stings and aspects. They wear mail armour at higher levels and rely on ammunition for their ranged weapon.
talent_levels_note: A talent ability can be taken once you can reach its row: the first talent point comes at level 10 and each row needs 5 more points, so row N opens at level 10 + 5 × (N − 1). Talent rows are from wowforevertalent.com; the Forever tooltips of Scatter Shot (30), Intimidation (30), Bestial Wrath (40), Deterrence (20), Trueshot Aura (25), Sniper Shot (40) and Strider Kick (30) show the same levels.

abilities.name: Aspect of the Monkey
abilities.text: The hunter takes on the aspects of a monkey, increasing chance to dodge by 8%. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
abilities.summary: The hunter takes on the aspects of a monkey, increasing chance to dodge by 8%.

abilities.name: Aspect of the Hawk
abilities.text: The hunter takes on the aspects of a hawk, increasing Ranged Attack Power by 20. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
abilities.summary: The hunter takes on the aspects of a hawk, increasing Ranged Attack Power by 20.

abilities.name: Aspect of the Beast
abilities.text: The hunter takes on the aspects of a beast, becoming untrackable and increasing Melee Attack Power by 50. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
abilities.summary: The hunter takes on the aspects of a beast, becoming untrackable and increasing Melee Attack Power by 50.

abilities.name: Aspect of the Cheetah
abilities.text: The hunter takes on the aspects of a cheetah, increasing movement speed by 30%. If the hunter takes damage, he will be dazed for 4 sec. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
abilities.summary: The hunter takes on the aspects of a cheetah, increasing movement speed by 30%.

abilities.name: Aspect of the Pack
abilities.text: The hunter and group members within 30 yards take on the aspects of a pack of cheetahs, increasing movement speed by 30%. If a pack member takes damage, they will be dazed for 4 sec. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
abilities.summary: The hunter and group members within 30 yards take on the aspects of a pack of cheetahs, increasing movement speed by 30%.

abilities.name: Aspect of the Wild
abilities.text: The hunter and all party and raid members within 30 yards take on the aspect of the wild, increasing Nature resistance by 45. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
abilities.summary: The hunter and all party and raid members within 30 yards take on the aspect of the wild, increasing Nature resistance by 45.

abilities.name: Beast Lore
abilities.text: Gather information about the target beast. The tooltip will display damage, health, armor, any special resistances, and diet.
abilities.summary: Gather information about the target beast.

abilities.name: Call Pet
abilities.text: Summons your pet to you.
abilities.summary: Summons your pet to you.

abilities.name: Dismiss Pet
abilities.text: Dismiss your pet. Dismissing your pet will reduce its happiness by 50.
abilities.summary: Dismiss your pet.

abilities.name: Feed Pet
abilities.text: Feed your pet the selected item. Feeding your pet increases happiness. Using food close to the pet's level will have a better result.
abilities.summary: Feed your pet the selected item.

abilities.name: Eyes of the Beast
abilities.text: Take direct control of your pet and see through its eyes for 2 min.
abilities.summary: Take direct control of your pet and see through its eyes for 2 min.

abilities.name: Eagle Eye
abilities.text: Zooms in the hunter's vision. Only usable outdoors. Lasts 1 min.
abilities.summary: Zooms in the hunter's vision.

abilities.name: Mend Pet
abilities.text: Heals your pet 20 health every second while you focus. Lasts 5 sec.
abilities.summary: Heals your pet 20 health every second while you focus.

abilities.name: Revive Pet
abilities.text: Revive your pet, returning it to life with 15% of its health.
abilities.summary: Revive your pet, returning it to life with 15% of its health.

abilities.name: Scare Beast
abilities.text: Scares a beast, causing it to run in fear for up to 10 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only one beast can be feared at a time.
abilities.summary: Scares a beast, causing it to run in fear for up to 10 sec.

abilities.name: Tame Beast
abilities.text: Begins taming a beast to be your companion. Your armor is reduced by 100% while you focus on taming the beast for 20 sec. If you lose the beast's attention for any reason, the taming process will fail. Once tamed, the beast will be very unhappy and disloyal. Try feeding the pet immediately to make it happy.
abilities.summary: Begins taming a beast to be your companion.

abilities.name: Tranquilizing Shot
abilities.text: Attempts to remove 1 Frenzy effect from an enemy creature.
abilities.summary: Attempts to remove 1 Frenzy effect from an enemy creature.

abilities.name: Beast Training
abilities.text: Lets you train your pet with various abilities that you have learned how to teach.
abilities.summary: Lets you train your pet with various abilities that you have learned how to teach.

abilities.name: Intimidation
abilities.text: Command your pet to Stun the target for 3 sec on its next successful attack, which also gains 100% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat.
abilities.summary: Command your pet to Stun the target for 3 sec on its next successful attack, which also gains 100% increased critical strike chance.

abilities.name: Bestial Wrath
abilities.text: Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec. While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.
abilities.summary: Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec.

abilities.note: Shown by Wowhead Forever as a trained spell requiring level 60, not a talent; wowforevertalent.com lists it as a row 4 Beast Mastery talent.
abilities.name: Summon Hawk
abilities.text: Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing 108 Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 sec. Only 2 hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot.
abilities.summary: Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing 108 Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 sec.

abilities.name: Arcane Shot
abilities.text: An instant shot that causes 25 Arcane damage.
abilities.summary: An instant shot that causes 25 Arcane damage.

abilities.name: Concussive Shot
abilities.text: Dazes the target, slowing movement speed by 50% for 4 sec.
abilities.summary: Dazes the target, slowing movement speed by 50% for 4 sec.

abilities.name: Distracting Shot
abilities.text: Distract the target, causing threat.
abilities.summary: Distract the target, causing threat.

abilities.name: Flare
abilities.text: Exposes all hidden and invisible enemies within 10 yards of the targeted area for 30 sec.
abilities.summary: Exposes all hidden and invisible enemies within 10 yards of the targeted area for 30 sec.

abilities.name: Hunter's Mark
abilities.text: Places the Hunter's Mark on the target, increasing the Ranged Attack Power of all attackers against that target by 26. In addition, the target of this ability can always be seen by the hunter whether it stealths or turns invisible. The target also appears on the mini-map. Lasts for 2 min.
abilities.summary: Places the Hunter's Mark on the target, increasing the Ranged Attack Power of all attackers against that target by 26.

abilities.name: Multi-Shot
abilities.text: Fires several missiles, hitting 3 targets. Multi-Shot shares its cooldown with Aimed Shot.
abilities.summary: Fires several missiles, hitting 3 targets.

abilities.name: Rapid Fire
abilities.text: Increases ranged and melee attack speed by 40% for 15 sec.
abilities.summary: Increases ranged and melee attack speed by 40% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Scorpid Sting
abilities.text: Stings the target, reducing the target's chance to hit with attacks by 2% for 20 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.
abilities.summary: Stings the target, reducing the target's chance to hit with attacks by 2% for 20 sec.

abilities.name: Serpent Sting
abilities.text: Stings the target, causing 15 Nature damage over 15 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.
abilities.summary: Stings the target, causing 15 Nature damage over 15 sec.

abilities.name: Viper Sting
abilities.text: Stings the target, draining 616 mana over 8 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.
abilities.summary: Stings the target, draining 616 mana over 8 sec.

abilities.name: Volley
abilities.text: Continuously fires a volley of ammo at the target area, causing 70 Arcane damage to enemy targets within 8 yards every 1 sec for 6 sec.
abilities.summary: Continuously fires a volley of ammo at the target area, causing 70 Arcane damage to enemy targets within 8 yards every 1 sec for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Aimed Shot
abilities.text: An aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 40. Aimed Shot shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot.
abilities.summary: An aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 40.

abilities.name: Scatter Shot
abilities.text: A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Turns off your attack when used.
abilities.summary: A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec.

abilities.note: Forever's Trueshot Aura is a talent (row 4); the Classic trained spell (ID 19506, level 40) is a later rank.
abilities.name: Trueshot Aura
abilities.text: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party or raid members within 45 yds by 20.
abilities.summary: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party or raid members within 45 yds by 20.

abilities.name: Sniper Shot
abilities.text: A long-range shot that deals ranged damage plus 320 and increases the range of your next 3 Shots by 10 yards for 10 sec.
abilities.summary: A long-range shot that deals ranged damage plus 320 and increases the range of your next 3 Shots by 10 yards for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Raptor Strike
abilities.text: A strong attack that deals melee weapon damage plus 5.
abilities.summary: A strong attack that deals melee weapon damage plus 5.

abilities.name: Mongoose Bite
abilities.text: Counterattack the enemy for melee weapon damage plus 15. Can only be performed after you dodge.
abilities.summary: Counterattack the enemy for melee weapon damage plus 15.

abilities.name: Wing Clip
abilities.text: Inflicts 5 damage and reduces the enemy target's movement speed by 50% for 10 sec.
abilities.summary: Inflicts 5 damage and reduces the enemy target's movement speed by 50% for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Disengage
abilities.text: Attempts to disengage from the target by reducing threat. Disables auto-attack.
abilities.summary: Attempts to disengage from the target by reducing threat.

abilities.name: Immolation Trap
abilities.text: Place a Fire trap that will burn the first enemy to approach for 105 Fire damage over 15 sec. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Fire trap can be active at a time.
abilities.summary: Place a Fire trap that will burn the first enemy to approach for 105 Fire damage over 15 sec.

abilities.name: Freezing Trap
abilities.text: Place a Frost trap that freezes the first enemy that approaches, preventing all action for up to 10 sec. Any damage caused will break the ice. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Frost trap can be active at a time.
abilities.summary: Place a Frost trap that freezes the first enemy that approaches, preventing all action for up to 10 sec.

abilities.name: Frost Trap
abilities.text: Place a Frost trap that creates an ice slick around itself for 30 sec when the first enemy approaches it. All enemies within 10 yards will be slowed by 60% while in the area of effect. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Frost trap can be active at a time.
abilities.summary: Place a Frost trap that creates an ice slick around itself for 30 sec when the first enemy approaches it.

abilities.name: Explosive Trap
abilities.text: Place a Fire trap that explodes when an enemy approaches, causing 105 to 135 Fire damage and 150 additional Fire damage over 20 sec to all within 10 yards. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Fire trap can be active at a time.
abilities.summary: Place a Fire trap that explodes when an enemy approaches, causing 105 to 135 Fire damage and 150 additional Fire damage over 20 sec to all within 10 yards.

abilities.name: Feign Death
abilities.text: Feign death which may trick enemies into ignoring you. Lasts 6 min. If not cancelled, after 6 min you will actually die.
abilities.summary: Feign death which may trick enemies into ignoring you.

abilities.name: Track Beasts
abilities.text: Shows the location of all nearby beasts on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
abilities.summary: Shows the location of all nearby beasts on the minimap.

abilities.name: Track Humanoids
abilities.text: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
abilities.summary: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap.

abilities.name: Track Undead
abilities.text: Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
abilities.summary: Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap.

abilities.name: Track Hidden
abilities.text: Increases stealth detection and shows hidden units within detection range on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
abilities.summary: Increases stealth detection and shows hidden units within detection range on the minimap.

abilities.name: Track Elementals
abilities.text: Shows the location of all nearby elementals on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
abilities.summary: Shows the location of all nearby elementals on the minimap.

abilities.name: Track Demons
abilities.text: Shows the location of all nearby demons on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
abilities.summary: Shows the location of all nearby demons on the minimap.

abilities.name: Track Giants
abilities.text: Shows the location of all nearby giants on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
abilities.summary: Shows the location of all nearby giants on the minimap.

abilities.name: Track Dragonkin
abilities.text: Shows the location of all nearby dragonkin on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.
abilities.summary: Shows the location of all nearby dragonkin on the minimap.

abilities.name: Deterrence
abilities.text: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.
abilities.summary: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.

abilities.note: Tooltip says level 30; row 4 opens at level 25.
abilities.name: Counterattack
abilities.text: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 26 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.
abilities.summary: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack.

abilities.name: Strider Kick
abilities.text: A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec.
abilities.summary: A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec.

changes: New talent abilities: Sniper Shot (Marksmanship, row 7) and Strider Kick (Survival, row 5).
Trueshot Aura is now a Marksmanship talent (row 4) with no Barrage requirement.
Summon Hawk is new: a hawk dive-bombs the target (level 60 on Wowhead).
Talents moved or added: Focused Fire, Careful Aim, Rapid Killing, Lone Wolf, Improved Tracking, Predator's Edge and others are new passives; Counterattack moves to row 4 and Scatter Shot to row 5.

Many spells are marked Changed on wowforevertalent.com (Aspect of the Beast, Aspect of the Monkey, Aspect of the Wild, Intimidation, Feign Death, Multi-Shot, Rapid Fire, stings, traps and others); only rank 1 values are shown here.
conflicts: Summon Hawk: Wowhead tooltip is not a talent and requires level 60; wowforevertalent.com lists it as a row 4 Beast Mastery talent. Treated as a trained spell.
Counterattack: tooltip says level 30, wowforevertalent.com puts it in row 4 (level 25). Talent level follows the row.
Trueshot Aura: the 19506 tooltip (level 40, non-talent) is probably a trained rank; the talent version 1299346 is used as first rank.
gaps: Pet abilities (Bite, Claw, Growl, Dash, Swipe, Web, Dismember and others).
Passive talents, including the many new ones (Focused Fire, Careful Aim, Rapid Killing, Lone Wolf, Lacerating Strikes and others).
Every rank after the first and the level it is trained at.
Explosive Trap Wowhead tooltip is level 34; Aspect of the Beast and Track spells were not on the Tavern guide but confirmed by tooltip.
Quest/trainer-learned details for Beast Training, Tame Beast and similar.
